name: Amendment 1 — Safety Update
C17649: Not applicable — primary reason is not Other
C17649_2: Not applicable — secondary reasons do not include Other
C42581: Amendment to update inclusion/exclusion criteria following a new safety signal identified in an interim data review. An elevation of liver enzymes (ALT >3× ULN) was observed in 3 of 60 participants in the inhaled Exoticillin arm. Criterion 4 of the exclusion criteria has been updated to exclude patients with pre-existing hepatic impairment, and an additional safety monitoring visit at Week 12 has been added for all participants.
C218699: New laboratory finding requires additional liver-function monitoring visits for all enrolled participants; participant information sheets and consent forms will be updated accordingly.
C218701: Not applicable — no substantial impact on reliability or robustness was identified.

ChgData.C218483_r1: Updated exclusion criterion 4 to exclude patients with elevated liver enzymes (ALT >3× ULN at screening).
ChgData.C181233_r1: New safety signal identified in interim data review: hepatic enzyme elevation in 5% of participants in the inhaled Exoticillin arm.
ChgData.C218483_r2: Added additional safety monitoring visit at Week 12 for all enrolled participants (liver-function tests: ALT, AST, bilirubin).
ChgData.C181233_r2: Required by updated safety monitoring plan in response to interim safety signal.

name: Amendment 3 — Protocol Correction (Bavaria Site)
C218694: $NCIT#C218487 "This protocol has been amended previously. Details of prior amendments are presented in Section 12.3 Prior Protocol Amendment(s)."
C17649: Site-specific procedural clarification requested by local competent authority (BfArM) regarding biospecimen handling at sub-zero temperatures.
C17649_2: Post-hoc editorial correction to German-language patient information sheet following mistranslation identified during internal QC review.
C42581: Site-specific amendment for investigational site DE-007 (Munich, Bavaria) to clarify biospecimen storage procedures and correct a mistranslation in the German-language patient information sheet. The biospecimen handling clarification was requested by the BfArM following a routine site inspection; the translation correction was identified during a scheduled internal quality control review. No changes are made to the core protocol design, endpoints, or statistical analysis plan.
C218699: The corrected patient information sheet removes ambiguous wording regarding optional sub-study participation; this directly affects the informed consent process and therefore constitutes a substantial impact on participants' rights.
C218701: The biospecimen handling clarification specifies storage temperature tolerances (−80 °C ± 10 °C) that were previously undefined; failure to store samples correctly could compromise biomarker assay results, affecting data reliability for the secondary endpoints.

ChgData.C218483_r1: Revised Section 8.4 (Biospecimen Handling) to specify storage temperature as −80 °C ± 10 °C and maximum freeze-thaw cycles as 2, applicable to site DE-007 only.
ChgData.C181233_r1: BfArM inspection finding (Ref: BfArM-2025-DE007-INS-04): site-specific clarification required for biospecimen storage conditions.
ChgData.C218483_r2: Corrected mistranslation in German-language Patient Information Sheet v1.2: 'Teilnahme ist obligatorisch' amended to 'Teilnahme ist freiwillig' (participation is voluntary, not mandatory) in the sub-study consent section.
ChgData.C181233_r2: Internal QC review (QC-2025-112) identified mistranslation that incorrectly described optional sub-study participation as mandatory.
ChgData.C218483_r3: Updated site DE-007 contact details: Principal Investigator changed from Dr. H. Brandt to Dr. A. Müller effective 1 February 2026 following PI transfer.
ChgData.C181233_r3: Site-initiated PI transfer approved by Ethics Committee (EC Ref: LMU-2025-487) and notified to BfArM.
